dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Posterior circulation (cerebellar) transient ischemic attack, most likely due to small-vessel cerebrovascular disease given prior stroke history

Alternatives:
1. Acute cerebellar ischemic stroke not yet visible on initial MRI (requires repeat imaging in 24-48 hours)
2. Vestibular neuronitis
3. Cerebellar demyelination or occult posterior fossa lesion (despite normal MRI)
